figurative_meaning_en: one by one, indicating each person individually
example_sentences_in_bangla: নামেনামে আসন রাখা হয়েছে, কেউ ভুল করে বসবেন না।
পরীক্ষার ফলাফল নামেনামে ঘোষণা করা হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Seats have been arranged by name, so no one should sit in the wrong place.
The exam results will be announced by name.
note: This idiom emphasizes precision in identification, often used in administrative or social contexts in Bengali culture.
